claims.span: lower median detection delay than Lanyard-TS on three benchmarks
claims.proposition: Sprocket-AD has lower median detection delay than Lanyard-TS on three benchmarks.
On Rookhaven-Server, Sprocket-AD's median detection delay is 12 versus Lanyard-TS's 15.
On Quayside-Grid v2, Sprocket-AD's median detection delay is 8 versus Lanyard-TS's 9.
On Whitlow-Rail, Sprocket-AD's median detection delay is 17 versus Lanyard-TS's 21.
Sprocket-AD has higher median detection delay than Lanyard-TS on two benchmarks.
On Mallowmere-Water, Sprocket-AD's median detection delay is 30 versus Lanyard-TS's 26.
On Tinderbox-HVAC, Sprocket-AD's median detection delay is 41 versus Lanyard-TS's 39.

claims.span: Sprocket-AD achieves a higher average event-F1 (78.4%) than Lanyard-TS (77.2%) across the five benchmarks
claims.proposition: Across the five benchmarks, Sprocket-AD achieves a higher average event-F1 of 78.4% than Lanyard-TS's 77.2%.
Sprocket-AD has higher event-F1 than Lanyard-TS on four benchmarks.
On Rookhaven-Server, Sprocket-AD's event-F1 is 88.7 versus Lanyard-TS's 86.9.
On Mallowmere-Water, Sprocket-AD's event-F1 is 74.2 versus Lanyard-TS's 72.8.
On Tinderbox-HVAC, Sprocket-AD's event-F1 is 69.5 versus Lanyard-TS's 67.1.
On Whitlow-Rail, Sprocket-AD's event-F1 is 81.3 versus Lanyard-TS's 80.6.

claims.span: equal event-F1 on Quayside-Grid v2 (78.4 vs 78.4)
claims.proposition: Sprocket-AD and Lanyard-TS have equal event-F1 of 78.4 on Quayside-Grid v2.

claims.proposition: Ablation results indicate that both the frequency branch and adaptive thresholds contribute to Sprocket-AD's accuracy.

claims.span: the full model (78.4% average event-F1) outperforms variants without the frequency branch (76.9%)
claims.proposition: The full Sprocket-AD model, with 78.4% average event-F1, outperforms the variant without the frequency branch, which has 76.9%.

claims.span: the full model (78.4% average event-F1) outperforms variants without the frequency branch (76.9%), without adaptive thresholds (77.5%)
claims.proposition: The full Sprocket-AD model, with 78.4% average event-F1, outperforms the variant without adaptive thresholds, which has 77.5%.

claims.proposition: The full Sprocket-AD model, with 78.4% average event-F1, outperforms the variant without both the frequency branch and adaptive thresholds, which has 75.8%.
Sprocket-AD is more parameter-efficient than Lanyard-TS, with 3.2M versus 5.8M parameters.
Sprocket-AD is faster in training than Lanyard-TS, taking 14 versus 22 min.

claims.proposition: Sprocket-AD is faster in inference than Lanyard-TS, taking 0.9 versus 1.4 ms per window.

claims.proposition: Dunmore-Iso is faster in training than Sprocket-AD, with a training time of 2 min.
